resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1958. FireLookout.com, WillhiteWeb and the blog say it was destroyed in 1958. The story reports both words.

The blog dates Carl Colquhoun's drowning to July 31, 1931, while packing lumber for a lookout cabin. WillhiteWeb says he drowned in 1933 at Pyramid Creek. The story gives both dates and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Brief listed access as unknown; no closure notice or official access statement was found in the sources read, and WillhiteWeb gives distance and gravel-road access only (it does not call the trail open). Sources disagree on the drowning year (1931 vs 1933) and on the spelling Colquhoun vs Calquehoun; the story uses Colquhoun. The blog is a personal history blog, used for the 1931 date, the 1932 naming approval and the 1943 end date (which WillhiteWeb also gives). The blog's suggestion that the CCC built the lookout is speculation and is not used. The firelookout.org WA list row (Ground, Gone, FFLOS US 796) matches the brief but is not cited. No photos added.
